summary: McDowell County, WV tower built in 1940 by the Division of Forestry; NHLR-registered 1995; listed as standing, unstaffed, with road access limited, per a 2013 visit report.

facts.design: 41' Blau-Knox tower with a 7' x 7' metal cab; cab windows swing open in four-pane blocks
facts.status_note: Newest source is a Register visit report dated July 15, 2013; the Forest Fire Lookout Association list also shows it standing

access.note: Per the 2013 Register visit report, only authorized vehicles can drive to the tower and the public is discouraged from driving; the foot trail is unmarked

visit.trail_note: A foot trail from the group camp leads to the tower. The 2013 report says it is unmarked and not well maintained. Ask West Virginia State Parks before going.

facts.agency: West Virginia Division of Forestry built and administered it (NHLR); the 2013 visit report says State Parks maintains it

events.note: NHLR: built by the West Virginia Division of Forestry to oversee Panther State Forest
Registered December 15, 1995; nominated by Jim Circle, District Forester
Register visit report dated July 15, 2013 (Jan Dzierzak): decent condition, wood steps need replacing, not staffed
Same visit report: forestry no longer uses the tower; State Parks maintains it and uses it as a radio repeater site

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register lists the WV Division of Forestry as administrator, but its 2013 visit report says forestry no longer uses the tower and State Parks maintains it. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Brief said access unknown; set to restricted from the 2013 Register visit report, the newest source found. That report is over 13 years old, so current access and condition are unverified. No watchers, staffing history or notable fires appear in the sources read. Build year, Blau-Knox type and state forest dates agree across sources. The Register spells it Blau-Knox; the Old Sentinel sources spell the maker Blaw-Knox. Used 3 page reads and 1 search. Stopped early because the sources are thin on history and nothing else turned up.
